You will bring the genomics expertise the team needs to pull reliable signals out of sequencing data that is often ambiguous.

You will build the methodological foundations and implement the algorithms needed for detecting variants (SNVs, Indels, CNVs, SVs) that are hard to call accurately in low fraction (fetal, donor cfDNA) samples. Panel and Assay Science: Provide genomics algorithm insights to our expanded panel roadmap, including which genes are worth considering and why, working with Product, the Laboratory Directors, and Research, who own that decision jointly. Help define the approach for analytically difficult genes and assay edge cases, and weigh what is scientifically defensible against what is technically possible.

Caller Strategy and Method Development: Define the computational strategy for new targeted and special-purpose callers. Help decide when a new caller is justified and when an existing method should be extended instead. Prototype and benchmark new methods, and work with the engineering team to get methods into production.

Scientific Investigation and Escalation: Serve as a genomics consultant on complex production escalations, separating biological causes from analytical and pipeline ones. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Enterprise, Feature Management
description:
About the Job:

The Enterprise team builds LaunchDarkly for the customers who push it hardest. Global banks, national health systems, and Fortune 100 manufacturers run us across thousands of engineers and tens of thousands of flags, inside audit and change control processes most software never meets.

That scale breaks things that work fine everywhere else. A permissions model designed for a hundred users can be the reason a rollout to twenty thousand stalls. Volume creates a different class of problem, where a flag payload that costs nothing to deliver once gets expensive across a large service fleet. Your work is to find where a current design stops holding and build what replaces it. You will own that end to end, in Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

The problems fall into a few areas:

• Governance and access control. Roles, permissions, approvals, and audit trails that satisfy a regulator.

• Scale and performance. Finding the limit before the customer does, then changing the design rather than tuning around it.

• Programmatic control. Our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces, so a platform team can run LaunchDarkly as infrastructure.

• Resilience under real constraints. Data residency, regional isolation, and sane behavior when a dependency is degraded.

Enterprise runs closer to its own business than most product teams. Roughly half the roadmap traces back to requests from named customers, so you will often know who is waiting on your work and what it unblocks for them. You will speak with those customers directly. The other half is larger forward-looking work, where the brief is a capability our biggest customers will need rather than one they have already asked for.

Responsibilities:

• Own features end to end: problem framing with your PM and designer, technical design, implementation across backend and frontend, rollout, and the operational life of the thing after it ships.

• Design for enterprise constraints from the start. Permissions and access control, approval and audit requirements, data residency and regional isolation, and the behavior of the system when a region or dependency is degraded.

• Find and fix scalability and performance limits before customers do. Identify where a current design stops holding at the top end of our customer base, quantify it, and lead the work to change it.

• Make LaunchDarkly manageable at fleet scale. Extend our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces so a platform team can operate LaunchDarkly as infrastructure rather than click through it.

• Work directly with customers. Join escalations and discovery calls, read the support and account signal, and turn a specific customer's problem into something that serves the whole segment rather than a one-off.

• Raise operability of what the team owns. Observability, runbooks, and participation in the on-call rotation, plus the follow-through after an incident.

• Drive alignment beyond your own team. Enterprise depends on and is depended on by several other teams, so surfacing a misalignment early and getting the right people in a room is a real part of the job at this level.

• Mentor and review. Give substantive review on specifications and pull requests, including for engineers on neighboring teams, and help newer engineers get faster.

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of features you drove from design through production.

• Genuine full stack ability. Strong in a statically typed backend language and comfortable owning frontend work rather than handing it off. Our stack is Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

• Experience building for enterprise customers. Multi-tenancy, roles and permissions, SSO and identity, audit logging, approval workflows, or compliance requirements in a production product.

• Demonstrated work on scale and performance problems: finding a bottleneck,

title: Sr. Product Data Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to be a strategic partner to our product teams and make sure data sits at the core of how we make decisions. In this role, you’ll lead data-driven initiatives, design scalable experimentation frameworks, and champion the Continuous Discovery Habits philosophy across Product, Engineering, and Design.

 

You’ll hold teams accountable to product metrics, assumption testing, and experimentation best practices while mentoring other analysts and influencing roadmaps through clear, compelling storytelling with data. This role blends analytical depth, experimentation strategy, and cross-functional leadership in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

 

Location: This is a remote position. You must live and work permanently in the U.S. to be considered.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead continuous discovery efforts by guiding PMs in defining and measuring success metrics, running assumption tests, and building iterative learning into how they work

- Design robust experimentation frameworks, evaluate experiment results, and iterate on key hypotheses

- Build scalable product analytics frameworks that standardize how teams make data-driven decisions

- Enable self-service analytics by improving access to data through Metabase, Amplitude, and Secoda so teams can explore product insights independently

- Mentor junior analysts on statistical methodology, experimentation best practices, and storytelling with data

- Present insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership regularly to influence product roadmaps

- Champion best practices for both Product Managers and internal data teams around data-driven decision making, experimentation, data governance, and standardization

- Leverage SQL, dbt, and Snowplow to transform, and analyze product data

- Connect data insights to broader business strategy and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Help foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, and data-driven learning across Product and Engineering teams

THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems-and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

- Raising the bar on how product teams define, measure, and act on success metrics

- Making experimentation faster, more rigorous, and more trusted across the org

- Influencing product roadmaps with insights that tie directly to business strategy

- Scaling analytics practices so decision-making quality holds as we grow

- Leveling up other analysts through mentorship and shared best practices

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, or a similar role

- Strong proficiency in SQL, dbt, Snowplow, Amplitude, and Secoda (or equivalent tools)

- Experience with A/B testing, hypothesis-driven research, and experiment design

- Expertise in statistical modeling, causal inference, and data visualization

- Experience designing and implementing analytics frameworks for scalable decision-making

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence product teams and executives through insights and strategic recommendations

- Proficiency in storytelling with data and translating insights into strategy

- Prior experience in SaaS or fast-growing tech environments preferred

- Comfortable working in a high-autonomy, high-accountability environment

- Passion for fostering a culture of experimentation and data-driven learning

- A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.

- A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.
